verdict.rationale: Poke's release notes say users can share images of existing data, such as spreadsheets, so Poke can extract and visualize it. That is first-party evidence that it reads image content, but only within the charting feature. Nothing in the pack covers general screenshot or photo understanding, or how accurately it interprets images. Missing for 10: documented general-purpose screenshot/photo interpretation, coverage of non-data images, evidence of accuracy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can share screenshots and photos and have the assistant accurately interpret what is in them

citations.quote: share images of existing data (like spreadsheets) for Poke to extract and visualize
